name: EasyLife
author: Paul Hickman

provenance.note: The release before the registered 1.10, shipped in the same Aminet upload as 1.10 itself. 155 of its 156 keyword names carry over.
provenance.redistribution: Uploaded to Aminet, whose terms require the submitter to state distribution conditions. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: EasyLife is the documented case of a keyword prefix changing between releases (znsx to elznsx). 157 keywords, none ported.
